Wooden frame with grid/cubby layout; no clear branding visible.

claims.claim: It a open wardrobe, can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an open wardrobe/closet rack suitable for home or shop use.
No receipt/date or label shown in photo 0.
Photo 0 is partially obscured by clothes inside; surface condition cannot be confirmed.
Photo 0 does not clearly show foam components; wardrobe appears mostly frame/cubbies.

risks.risk: Hidden damage (stains/tears/warping) not visible because clothes fill the compartments and surfaces.
risks.proof: Ask for 3 close-up photos: (1) top frame joints, (2) inside back panel/corners, (3) each shelf/cubby empty showing full surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown condition (worst case within the comparable range).

risks.risk: “Foam still firm” may be incorrect or refers to a part not shown; could indicate missing/incorrect item components.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the foam part(s) clearly (if any), including a close-up and a hand-press video to show firmness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wardrobe only, ignoring foam claim (worst case: foam not present or not reliable).

risks.risk: Odor/smoke exposure not detectable from the photo; could affect usability.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the wardrobe being opened/closed and a smell/odor check note, plus confirmation it has been aired; ideally request a quick wipe test photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if odor may be present (worst case: needs cleaning/airing).

risks.risk: Stability/structural integrity (loose joints, wobble) not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing the wardrobe being gently pushed from different sides to demonstrate it doesn’t wobble, plus close-ups of joints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if stability is unknown (worst case: may need tightening/repair).

proof_requests: Empty the wardrobe and send clear photos of all cubbies/shelves and the back panel (no clothes covering surfaces).
Close-up photos of all joints/edges and any fasteners (top, sides, bottom).
If there is any foam component: show it clearly with a close-up and a short firmness test video.
Send a short wobble/stability video (push test from front/side) and confirm it’s fully assembled.
response.reason: The item type (open wardrobe/wardrobe rack with cubbies and hanging space) is visible in photo 0, but condition details are partially obscured; pricing should use the worst-case assumption within the provided comparables.
